snippets.name: quantities
snippets.title: Quantities on binders
snippets.lede: 0 is erased at run time, 1 is used exactly once, and ω may be used any number of times. The checker prices every use.

snippets.name: vectors
snippets.title: A length in the type
snippets.lede: Vec A n is a list whose type records how many elements it has. The length is erased, and head has no nil case to write.

snippets.name: equality
snippets.title: Observational equality
snippets.lede: Functions are equal when they agree on every argument, and propositions are equal when each implies the other: propositional equality computes.

snippets.title: A program that leaves the browser
snippets.lede: The kernel, elaborator and compiler are written in Wiz itself; the same source compiles through C or LLVM to a native executable.
